title: Convergence-Rate-Guided Algorithm Design of Expected Improvement for Continuous Simulation Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expected improvement (EI) based on stochastic kriging (SK) surrogate is widely used in continuous simulation optimization, but unknown heteroscedastic noise on simulation output makes three basic design choices consequential: the incumbent used to define improvement, the replication level at each sampled point, and the terminal recommendation. Existing methods typically either assume the noise levels are known or choose these components separately through heuristic rules or empirical calibration. We instead derive a high-probability upper bound on the simple regret and systematically choose the three components within general rule classes to tighten this bound. We first establish a finite-sample confidence bound for the SK predictor with unknown and estimated noise levels as a foundation for the three design choices. We then analyze general posterior-quantile families for both the incumbent and the terminal recommendation. For the incumb

translated_title: 基于收敛率引导的连续仿真优化期望改进算法设计
translated_abstract: 基于随机克里金替代模型的期望改进方法被广泛应用于连续仿真优化，但仿真输出上未知的异方差噪声使得三个基本设计选择变得至关重要：用于定义改进的当前最优解、每个采样点的重复次数，以及终端推荐。现有方法通常要么假设噪声水平已知，要么通过启发式规则或经验校准分别选择这些组件。我们转而推导简单遗憾的高概率上界，并在一般规则类内系统地选择这三个组件以收紧该上界。我们首先为具有未知和已估计噪声水平的随机克里金预测器建立有限样本置信界，作为三个设计选择的基础。随后我们分析了用于当前最优解和终端推荐的一般后验分位数族。
tldr: 该论文通过推导简单遗憾的高概率上界，在收敛率分析的基础上系统性地设计了随机克里金期望改进算法的三个关键组件——当前最优解、采样重复次数和终端推荐，解决了未知异方差噪声下连续仿真优化中依赖启发式规则进行算法设计的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically designs the three key components (incumbent, replication level, and terminal recommendation) of stochastic kriging-based expected improvement algorithms by deriving a high-probability upper bound on simple regret, replacing heuristic rules in continuous simulation optimization under unknown heteroscedastic noise.
